title: erigeron griseus
intro: Erigeron griseus, commonly known as Frost Plant or Silvery Fleabane, is a perennial herb in the daisy family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including gastrointestinal problems and respiratory infections, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron griseus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron griseus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
